recipes.title: Italian potato frittata, light
recipes.summary: A lighter Italian frittata with tender potatoes, spinach, basil and parmesan. Extra greens and less cheese and oil keep this Mediterranean breakfast generous.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 190°C.
Prepare the potato, spinach, onion, basil and garlic in their listed forms.
Simmer the potato until just tender while the slices still hold their shape.
Heat the olive oil in a wide ovenproof frying pan.
Cook the onion until soft and translucent.
Add the garlic and stir until fragrant.
Fold the spinach into the pan until wilted.
Whisk the eggs, whole milk, parmesan cheese, basil and salt until evenly combined.
Arrange the potato evenly over the spinach and onion.
Pour the egg mixture into the pan.
Cook the frittata until the edges begin to set.
Bake until the centre is just set and the top is lightly golden.
Rest the Italian potato frittata before slicing.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate for up to 3 days and serve cold, at room temperature or gently reheated. Freeze individual slices for up to 1 month.

recipes.title: Japanese mushroom takikomi rice, light
recipes.summary: Japanese seasoned rice cooked with mushrooms, shiitake, carrots and green beans in a savoury soy and ginger broth. Extra vegetables keep this vegan lunch lighter.

steps.instruction: Rinse the white rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear.
Soak the white rice in fresh water so the grains cook evenly.
Prepare the mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, carrot, green beans, ginger and spring onions in their listed forms.
Stir the vegetable broth, soy sauce, rice wine, sesame oil and ginger together.
Drain the white rice and place it in the rice cooker.
Arrange the mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, carrot and green beans evenly over the rice.
Cook the takikomi rice until the rice cooker completes its cycle.
Rest the cooked rice with the lid closed so the moisture distributes evenly.
Fold the vegetables gently through the seasoned rice.
Finish the Japanese mushroom takikomi rice with the spring onions.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate for up to 3 days and reheat with a spoonful of vegetable broth or water. Freeze cooled portions for up to 1 month.

recipes.title: Korean vegetable pancakes, light
recipes.summary: Crisp Korean vegetable pancakes packed with zucchini, mushrooms, cabbage and spring onions. Extra vegetables and less flour and oil keep this vegetarian dinner lighter.

steps.instruction: Prepare the zucchini, onion, spring onions, mushrooms, carrot and green cabbage in their listed forms.
Whisk the wheat flour, water and eggs into a smooth batter.
Fold the zucchini, onion, spring onions, mushrooms, carrot and green cabbage into the batter.
Rest the vegetable batter so the wheat flour hydrates.
Stir the soy sauce and sesame oil together for dipping.
Heat part of the vegetable oil in a wide frying pan.
Spread a thin layer of batter across the hot pan.
Cook the first side until crisp and deeply golden.
Turn the pancake carefully.
Cook the second side until golden and the vegetables are tender.
Repeat the cooking process with the remaining batter and vegetable oil.
Rest the Korean vegetable pancakes briefly before slicing.
Serve the pancakes with the soy sauce dip.

recipes.storageNotes: Best served freshly cooked. Refrigerate for up to 2 days and reheat in a dry pan or hot oven until crisp. Freeze for up to 1 month.

recipes.title: Thai shrimp omelette with rice, light
recipes.summary: A crisp-edged Thai omelette with tender shrimp and spring onions, served with rice, cucumber and lime. Less rice and oil keep this high-protein breakfast lighter.

steps.instruction: Rinse the white rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear.
Cook the white rice until tender, then keep it covered so the grains finish steaming.
Prepare the shrimp, cucumber, spring onions and lime in their listed forms.
Beat the eggs until lightly foamy.
Stir the shrimp, spring onions and fish sauce into the eggs.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wide frying pan until very hot.
Pour the egg mixture into the hot oil.
Cook the first side until puffed and deeply golden at the edges.
Turn the omelette carefully.
Cook the second side until the shrimp are opaque and the eggs are set.
Rest the Thai shrimp omelette briefly so the centre settles.
Serve the omelette with the white rice, cucumber and lime.

recipes.storageNotes: Best served immediately while the omelette is crisp. Refrigerate leftovers for up to 2 days and reheat gently. Store the rice and cucumber separately. Do not freeze.

recipes.title: Turkish chicken shish with cacik, light
recipes.summary: Grilled chicken shish with peppers and onions, served with cool cucumber, dill and yogurt cacik. Less bread and oil keep this high-protein Turkish lunch lighter.

steps.instruction: Prepare the chicken breast, cucumber, bell pepper, onion, garlic, dill weed and pita bread in their listed forms.
Divide the greek yogurt between two bowls.
Mix half the greek yogurt with half the lemon juice, half the garlic, olive oil, cumin, paprika and half the salt.
Coat the chicken breast thoroughly with the yogurt marinade.
Marinate the chicken breast in the refrigerator.
Thread the chicken breast, bell pepper and onion onto skewers.
Stir the remaining greek yogurt with the cucumber, dill weed, remaining garlic, remaining lemon juice and remaining salt.
Heat the grill until very hot.
Grill the skewers until the first side is browned and lightly charred.
Turn the skewers.
Grill until the chicken breast is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Rest the chicken shish so the breast remains juicy.
Warm the pita bread briefly on the grill.
Serve the Turkish chicken shish with the cacik and pita bread.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the chicken shish and cacik separately for up to 3 days. Reheat the chicken gently and serve with freshly warmed pita bread. Freeze the cooked chicken for up to 2 months.
